messages:
Riley - MKTG: Short sprint: we need a compact asset pack for the "Serving Wins" mini-launch. Requirements: landing hero (desktop + mobile crops), 1-slide benchmark with sparkline + short caption, compact inbound-routing PNG for ops, and 3 microtiles with A/B color variants. Deadline: Tuesday COB.

June (Design): Understood. A/B color variants: do you want two palette sets (brand vs muted) or two contrast levels? Also need final CTA copy.

Riley - MKTG: Two palette sets please: brand (accented) and muted (product-forward). CTA: primary = "Try the demo", secondary = "Estimate cost". Keep microtile text swap-friendly for localization.

Oscar - Creative Ops: I uploaded a starter file and batch-export tokens: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/serve-wins-mini-pack. Component set is rdw/mini-tiles-2026. I can run exports but need frames named with final filenames.

June (Design): Will work mobile-first and build responsive components. Draft export spec: hero 1400x800 (svg + 72dpi png), hero-mobile 800x800 (png), microtiles 600x600 (svg/png) with both color variants, slide 1920x1080 (pptx + png), routing-diagram 1200x800 (svg).

Maya PMM: Microtile audiences: dev, infra, finance. I'll drop 1-line copy for each (60-80 chars) by 15:30. Also: include a tiny legend for quantization tradeoffs.

Hannah - Brand: Use stacked mark for hero. No shadows on logos. Approved palette only; exception allowed for muted variant but keep contrast >=4.5:1 for small type. Legal flagged one datapoint on the slide (cost numbers)  use rounded estimates and label source.

Riley - MKTG: Good catch. Label: "Estimated unit cost (illustrative)". Also we need an interactive Figma prototype link for PMMs to click through during rehearsal. June, can you publish a prototype page?

June (Design): Yep. I'll publish a short prototype with hero -> slide -> microtiles flow and include hotspot nav. Will tag Export Bot after frames are ready.

Export Bot: Frames named with pattern rdw_probe_<asset>_<audience>_v1 added to batch export by June (Design) at 2026-03-29T14:12:30Z.

Oscar - Creative Ops: Handoff checklist I'll produce: Figma link, export zip (png/svg/slide pptx), alt_text.md, filename_manifest.csv, localization_map.csv (EN/FR/DE). I'll run accessibility checks post-export.

Maya PMM: Dropped microtile copy in file comments. Riley  confirm CTA placement (microtile vs hero) and we are good to go.

Riley - MKTG: Place primary CTA on hero, microtiles get secondary CTAs. Ping #marketing-ops when PNGs exported. Thanks team :rocket:
